cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Cílem je poskytnout vědomosti o složení, jakosti a zdravotní nezávadnosti potravinářských surovin živočišného původu, které produkuje zemědělská činnost ke zpracování - mléko, maso, vejce, drůbež. Vysvětluje a učí dovednostem v hygienickém zpracování živočišných produktů - technologii potravin. Poskytuje dovednost orientace v legislativních podkladech pro danou potravinářskou činnost a dodavatelsko-odběratelské vztahy.

Slaughtering - meat quality and influences on it, nutritional value, meat defects, technology of slaughtering cattle and pigs. (allowance 3/3)
Cutting of meat - cutting of meat cuts (beef, pork, veal, sheep), cutting of meat for production including quality parameters. (allowance 3/3)
Production of meat products - technology of production of various types of meat products, raw materials for meat production (spices, salts, additives). (allowance 3/3)

Processing of rabbits and game meat - quality parameters, nutritional value, technology of slaughter processing. (allowance 3/3)

Cheese - production, rennet, range. (allowance 3/3)
Acid-set cheese - production, range. (allowance 3/3)
Processing of milk and milk products into concentrates and dried milk products. (allowance 3/3)
Manufacture of other dairy products - butter, frozen creams, sweetened and unsweetened condensed milk products. (allowance 3/3)

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim is to provide knowledge about the composition, quality of food and food safety of animal products from agricultural production – milk, meat, eggs, and poultry. Explains and teaches skills in the hygienic processing of animal products – food technology. Provides orientation skills in legislative background for a given food business and supplier-customer relations.
